name: Josie Maxwell
role: Wife of agent J. N. Maxwell, née Smith
bio: Josie Maxwell, née Smith, married railroad and express agent J. N. Maxwell in September 1885, and at the end of 1885 the couple were preparing to leave Medora for St. Paul, where he had taken a Wells-Fargo messenger's run. In December 1886 she was visiting her husband's parents in Port Byron, Ill.

moments.label: Visiting her husband's parents in Port Byron, Ill.
